notes.title: Froggonit development update
notes.content:
I just wanted to announce that I am 100% committed to releasing FROGGONIT this year.

Hopefully around November / December.

I'm focusing on the Steam version first and then I'll start working on the Switch version.



I'm working on the Raccoon Express 🚂 where you'll have to solve different things for your animal friends!



📚Added a library car
[previewyoutube="6xJmfW7ESFA;full"][/previewyoutube]


🍕And a dining car:
[previewyoutube="J34BEc3eoDQ;full"][/previewyoutube]


Next steps: I'll walk to the window and close it, it's cold in here!

DEVELOPMENT steps: Ohhh, I'm going to work on finishing all the different cars for the train.

I think that development is going very well and the game feels great! In every corner there is some object or animal to interact with. Or dance.



If you liked Restless Soul, I think you're going to love Froggonit! If feels more... alive 👻

If you didn't like Restless Soul, you are going to like Froggonit too.

If you don't know what Restless Soul is, don't worry, I don't know either.



Stay tuned for more updates and I'll see you... in the next video!

Wait, this wasn't a video.
